$comment: Farewell messages offered by Admin → Farewell Message Library. Add an entry, restart the server, and it appears in the dashboard. `closing` is shown separately on the stage and appended to the spoken text. Nothing here may be edited from the browser.

messages.title: Until We Meet Again
paragraphs: Dear friends, as we come to the end of this time together, we want to thank each and every one of you for joining us in prayer.
May God bless your families, strengthen your hearts, and fill your lives with peace, hope, and love.
Remember, you are never alone. God is always with you.
Thank you for praying with us today. Until we meet again, may the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all.
